martin.title: Martin NFC
martin.desc:
Martin NFC is a fullstack web and mobile application for smart pet identification using NFC-enabled collars. Scanning a tag opens a webpage showing key animal info (name, owner contact, address, medical data).

The backend is built with PHP/Symfony and Doctrine ORM, while the frontend uses HTML, CSS, JS, and Bootstrap. REST APIs connect to a MySQL database, and the app is containerized with Docker.

The project follows an Agile methodology with Git for version control and Trello for task management, demonstrating end-to-end mastery of secure and scalable software development.

react_question.title: Interactive Quiz App
react_question.desc: This React-based application allows users to take multiple-choice quizzes on various topics. After completing a quiz, the app automatically calculates and displays the user's score, providing instant feedback. It’s a dynamic and user-friendly way to learn, test knowledge, and track progress.

modal.title: HEP 5 - Leadership
modal.content:
HEP Micro-Certification–Leadership & Collective Performance

Awarded to: Hai Nam HOANG
Date of issue: March 11, 2025

Results

Demonstrated the ability to exercise leadership that enhances collective development and contributes to organizational performance.

Skills & Competencies

  • Select an appropriate leadership style based on individual characteristics, value systems, and situational contexts.
  • Build collective projects by combining personal human skills with those of the group.
  • Share expertise effectively to support collective success.

Evaluation Breakdown

  • 15% – Dynamic Spiral: Participation in in-person workshop activities, quality of work produced, and ability to adapt leadership style to different people and contexts.
  • 40% – Collective Project: Quality of the live pitch, strength of content presented, demonstration of autonomous team functioning, and successful integration of HEP competencies.
  • 30% – Ability to Share Knowledge: Workshop participation, depth of self-analysis regarding personal success strategy (especially in terms of knowledge transfer), and analysis of another individual’s success strategy.
  • 15% – Attendance: Completion of 100% of the module’s e-learning content.

Note: All evaluations are completed during the in-person workshop. No additional work is required outside of the training.

Status: ✅ Competency Acquired
